resources.string: I\'ve read and agree to the terms of use and privacy notice.
Read the new terms of use and privacy notice. If you continue, you agree to them.

Meadow reads your phone\'s app usage log to measure how long each app is open. Your full history stays on this phone. If you choose to share, only today\'s total and your top apps go to your Bumblebees.

The garden keeper is an accessibility service. It sees which app is on screen and closes apps whose time is used. In strict mode, it also reads the words on some settings screens, so nobody can turn Meadow off. All of this happens on this phone. Meadow never reads what you type. It never stores or sends what is on your screen.

Notification access lets the garden keeper see which app sends each notification. Then it can hide notifications from resting apps and pause their videos and music. All of this happens on this phone. Meadow never stores or sends your notifications or their content.
